examples.arabic: بلش شغله بحماس كبير، والكمامة على وجهه كأنه جراح عم يعمل عملية خطيرة.
examples.english: He started his work with great enthusiasm, a mask on his face as if he were a surgeon performing a dangerous operation.
examples.transliteration: Ballash shogholo bi hamaas kbeer, w-il-kamaame 'ala wajho ka'anno jarraah 'am ya'mol 'amaliyye khatira.

examples.arabic: بلش الصبح بقرية صغيرة بالجبل، و كانت السما صافية كالعادة، بس فجأة تغير الجو.
examples.english: The morning started in a small village in the mountains, and the sky was clear as usual, but suddenly the weather changed.
examples.transliteration: Balash es-sobuh bi-qarye zgheere bel jabal, w kanat es-sama safiye kal-aade, bas faj'a taghayyar el jaw.
examples.storyTitle: The Mountain Storm: Challenges and Unity

examples.arabic: سامي بلش يقرأ القصص كل ليلة بغرفته.
examples.english: Sami started reading the stories every night in his room.
examples.transliteration: Sami ballash yiqra al-qisas kull layla be-ghurfato.

examples.arabic: بلش سامي يعجن الطحين بدموعه وهو عم يفكر كيف الكره بيعمي القلوب، بس المحبة بتضل محفورة بالخبز والملح.
examples.english: Sami started kneading the flour with his tears, thinking about how hate blinds hearts, but love remains engraved in bread and salt.
examples.transliteration: Ballash Sami ya'jin al-tHin bi-dmou'o wa-huwa am yifakkir kif al-kureh bi-ya'mi al-quloub, bass al-maHabba b-tdall maHfourra bil-khubz wal-milH.
examples.storyTitle: A Loaf of Hope Amidst the Rubble

examples.arabic: فريقنا بلش اللعب مش منيح بس كان في لاعب طويل كتير
examples.english: Our team started playing not well, but there was a very tall player
examples.transliteration: farīqna ballash il-laʿeb mish mnīḥ bas kān fī lāʿeb ṭawīl ktīr

examples.english: The child started asking many questions.
examples.transliteration: Ballash el walad yis'al ktiir as'ileh.
